_comment: CA005 - Require MFA to register security information. Applies to: the Halden Microsoft Entra ID tenant (P2, lab only). A user registering a new MFA method is the moment an attacker with a stolen password would enrol their own authenticator, so registration itself is protected. Deployed by 07-New-ConditionalAccessPolicies.ps1, report-only first.
